name: Thumbscrew
description: Lives in prosthetic hands and improves grip calibration over time. Users report their prosthetic developing micro-adjustments that anticipate what they're reaching for.
observed_behavior: Learns user grip patterns and pre-adjusts motor tension. Catches falling objects before conscious reaction time allows.
location: Widespread — any district with prosthetic users
story_hooks: A freelancer's prosthetic hand catches a knife they didn't see — saving their life or someone else's
Thumbscrew begins optimizing for combat grips the user has never trained
